title: Raspberry Yoghurt Ice Pops
changes_from_base: A cooked, sieved raspberry purée whisked into sweetened Greek yoghurt and cream replaces the raw strawberry and jam mix.
summary: Tangy strained yoghurt ice pops rippled through with a cooked raspberry purée.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer 225 g raspberries with 85 ml water, 85 g caster sugar, ¼ tsp orange juice and a pinch of salt, stirring now and then, for about 10 min until broken down and slightly thick, then cool for 30 min.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend for 15 s, then strain out the seeds through a fine sieve to give about 240 ml purée.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk 155 g strained yoghurt with 55 g caster sugar, 55 ml double cream, ½ tsp orange juice and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Whisk the raspberry purée through the yoghurt mixture.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pour into six 90 ml moulds, add the sticks and freeze for at least 4 h.

tips: Cook the raspberries until well broken down so the purée strains easily.
Use well-strained Greek yoghurt for a thick, creamy texture rather than a watery one.
Whisk the purée in gradually so it ripples through the yoghurt rather than separating.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer.
